title: Ayanokōji — flat dismissal
text: It doesn't really matter to me. The result is the same either way.

title: Ayanokōji — internal calculation
text: If I push the lever now, an opportunity that may not return for months is gone. So I'll wait. The wait costs nothing.

title: Ayanokōji — deadpan menace
text: You misunderstand. I'm not threatening you. I'm describing what will happen.

title: Horikita — cold formality
text: I have no interest in friendship. I came here to graduate from Class A, and that requires no companionship.

title: Horikita — cutting logic
text: Why are you defending him? You know the data. Sentiment is not an argument.

title: Horikita — sharp dismissal
text: If you're going to follow me, at least keep up. I won't slow down for hesitation.

title: Kushida (public) — bubbly hello
text: Hi! It's so nice to finally meet you! Don't worry, everyone here is super welcoming, I promise!

title: Kushida (public) — cheerful invite
text: Oh, it's totally fine, really! I had so much fun. Let's do it again next weekend, okay? Pinky promise!

title: Kushida (public) — generous warmth
text: I baked these for the whole class. There's enough for everyone, so don't be shy!

title: Kushida (private) — cold venom
text: Of course I smile at her. It makes it easier to ruin her, don't you think?

title: Kushida (private) — quiet threat
text: If you say a single word about what you saw, I will end you. Quietly, slowly, and the whole school will help.

title: Kushida (private) — mocking contempt
text: Pathetic. You really thought I cared? About any of you? That smile costs me nothing.

title: Karuizawa — bossy front
text: Of course we're going to that café. Don't make me say it twice. I already told the others.

title: Karuizawa — fragile vulnerability
text: I wasn't scared. I just… I just don't like being alone in the dark, that's all.

title: Karuizawa — anxious confession
text: You can't tell anyone, okay? Promise me. If they find out, I don't know what I'll do.

title: Ichinose — warm sincerity
text: I really do believe in everyone here. There isn't a single person in our class I'm not proud of.

title: Ichinose — gentle reassurance
text: It's okay. Whatever happened today, we'll figure it out together. Let's just sit for a moment.

title: Ichinose — soft compassion
text: Please, don't apologize. You did the best you could. That's all I ever ask of anyone.

title: Sakayanagi — theatrical contempt
text: How quaint. You honestly believed that was your own decision?

title: Sakayanagi — chess-master poise
text: The board has already been arranged. Every move you make from here only confirms which piece you are.

title: Sakayanagi — aristocratic delight
text: I do enjoy these little games. It would be a shame to end them too quickly, wouldn't you agree?

title: Ryūen — low menace taunt
text: Heh. You think hiding behind your friends is going to save you? I'll find you anyway.

title: Ryūen — predatory pressure
text: Talk. Tell me a name. I don't have all night, and I'm not a patient man.

title: Ryūen — swaggering threat
text: I don't lose. Even when I lose, I don't lose. Remember that next time you try this.
